{"notes": "Visit 2 (left at 2:45). I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm crediting only what people said and what the picture shows.

State of the build: the tail is now a rounded sweep and the top and belly lines join around the right end. Every domino in the picture is connected to the start, so the earlier notched, open tail is fixed. The earlier stray at about (23.5, 8.3) is gone. One pale domino remains at the top-line dip, near (20.3, 7.8). The dominoes where the tail meets the belly, around x 23-26, y 13.3, look crowded and may be doubled up, so check that this stretch falls cleanly.

Sofia: Heard her for the first time, and it was good. At 2:15 she gave a clear plan: she'd bring the sweep down the right side, stop side-on at the belly tail tip, and not lay a second line over the belly. She told Jack to hold off so they wouldn't double up, and said she'd inspect the join. At 2:30 she confirmed the strays were safe to remove and said she was finishing the tail. Strong collaboration and communication, and she has followed through on her plan. This resolves my visit 1 concern. Verify the crowded join.

Omar: First evidence of him. He reported the belly done and continuous from the start, and the picture backs that up. He's clearing strays under the top line, and the earlier stray is gone, but one pale domino is still at the dip. He handed the tail join to Sofia and Jack, which is sensible. Good ownership so far. Ask him to finish the dip clean-up.

Hana: Not seen or heard this visit, so no new evidence. Her visit 1 leadership stands. Sofia's replies suggest her plan is being followed. Still haven't seen her build.

Jack: Not seen or heard this visit, so no new evidence. Sofia asked him to hold off on the join. Find out what he built, and whether he did the lower tail or the stray fix."}
